newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady on low demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were steady on Tuesday amid low demand by spinners but are likely to fall in the next few sessions, dealers said.
"Ginners have accumulated around 1.6 million tonnes of unsold stocks," dealer Kishin Chand said, adding that the situation could lead to a sharp price fall in a few days.

In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,100 ($52.21) and 2,260 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 between 2,360 and 2,400 and the MNH-93 between 2,255 and 2,350 rupees, dealers Oveis Razzak said.
